title: R2 fixes: sim AES-CTR and FIPS+SIM incompatibility
description: Two fixes in crypto2dev_sim.c:\n1. AES-CTR not handled in sim_ioctl_init: when algo is 'ctr(aes)', sim sets SIM_CIPHER_NONE and eventually returns EIO. The port translates this to WC_HW_E (hard error) instead of CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE (software fallback). Fix: for unrecognized cipher algo strings, return EOPNOTSUPP so the port returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE.\n2. WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_REQUIRE_FIPS + WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_SIM: silently fails at init (sim returns EOPNOTSUPP for REQUIRE_FIPS ioctl). Add #error or #warning for this incompatible combination.
